chunks: Muhammad ibn Yahya, from Ahmad ibn Muhammad, from Ali ibn al-Hakam, from al-Marzaban ibn al-Nu'man, raising it, said:
Rasool-Allah (peace be upon him and his family) said: 'What is the matter that I see you all with yellow teeth? What is the matter with you that you are not brushing your teeth?'
ai.seo_question: What is the significance of brushing teeth in Shia hadith?
ai.summary: In this hadith from *Al-Kafi*, the Prophet Muhammad (peace be upon him and his family) directly addresses the visible discoloration ('qulh') of his companions' teeth, linking it to their neglect of the *miswak* (toothbrush). This narration underscores the Prophetic emphasis on physical cleanliness as an integral component of spiritual purity and social etiquette, a practice highly valued in Shia jurisprudence for both health and worship preparation.

en.hubeali: Muhammad Bin Yahya, from Ahmad Bin Muhammad, from Ali Bin Al Hakam, from Al Marzaban Bin Al Noman, raising it, said,
‘Rasool-Allah<sup>saww</sup> said: ‘What is the matter I<sup>saww</sup> see you all with yellow teeth? What is the matter with you that you are not brushing your teeth?’
en.sarwar: 9. Muhammad ibn Yahya has narrated from Ahmad ibn Muhammad from Ali ibn al-Hakam from al-Marzaban ibn al-Nu’man in a marfu‘ manner has said the following: “He (the Imam) has said that the Messenger of Allah, O Allah, grant compensation to Muhammad and his family worthy of their services to Your cause, once said, ‘Why do I see you, people, with yellow teeth, what is the matter with you, why do you not brush your teeth?”
